Also concerned about $GOOG needing an answer to personalized bots, with cloud growth expectations of 92% Sept / 95% Dec and capex street at $201B CY26 / $312B CY27.
text:
I'm also getting more concerned about $AMZN because personalized bots will make it easy to find just what you're looking for, making them a logical starting point for anything we buy.

Amazon wins for three reasons: 1. Find what you want, 2. Speed, 3. Trust. Number 1 will increasingly be under attack.

Early data says this is happening, with Zuck's comment last week that Muse's main use case is commerce. 

Global daily bot usage is around 20m. I bet it's 2B in three years.

We're in the early stages of a multi year Mac super cycle. 

This morning, $AAPL announced some Mac updates, including 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac models (M6 chips). Still waiting on the first touchscreen Mac announcement later this morning.

Most important: I believe we are in the early stages of a multi-year AI-powered hardware upgrade cycle. I expect FY27 Mac to grow above 10% (Street at 6%) and FY28 above 10% (Street at 6%).
